name: WHO Reporting System for Breast Cytopathology
edition: IAC-IARC-WHO cytopathology reporting systems series, 1st ed., vol. 5 (2026) – online beta
specimen: FNAB, core touch preps, LBC, nipple discharge
use: Breast FNAB and related cytology; categories identical to Yokohama 2020.

adequacy.title: Adequacy
items: Follow Yokohama system page for full criteria and diagnoses.

categories.name: Insufficient / Inadequate

rom.source: WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text – online beta

categories.management: Review clinical/imaging; repeat FNAB or core (with ROSE) if suspicion is indeterminate or high. Low suspicion: repeat clinical/imaging in 3–6 months and re-aspirate if it changes. [WHO book, paraphrased]

diagnoses.name: Insufficient material
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Breast System – Insufficient/Inadequate

categories.name: Benign

rom.source: WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text – online beta

categories.management: Concordant benign triple test: clinical/imaging follow-up every 3–6 months or longer; re-aspirate promptly if it changes. Worrisome/indeterminate: repeat FNAB, core, or rarely excision. [WHO book, paraphrased]

diagnoses.name: Fibroadenoma
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Breast System – Benign

diagnoses.name: Fibrocystic change
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Breast System – Benign

categories.name: Atypical

rom.source: WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text – online beta

categories.management: Low suspicion: repeat clinical/imaging in 3–6 months, re-aspirate if changed. Indeterminate/suspicious: core biopsy preferred (repeat FNAB if core unavailable). Still atypical after resampling → tissue biopsy. [WHO book, paraphrased]

diagnoses.name: Atypical epithelial cells
diagnoses.final: Atypical (WHO Breast System). Atypical epithelial cells.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Breast System – Atypical

categories.name: Suspicious of malignancy

rom.source: WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text – online beta

categories.management: Repeat FNAB or preferably core biopsy (to show invasion and ER/PR/HER2). If not confirmed, correlate and consider resampling or excision biopsy. [WHO book, paraphrased]

diagnoses.name: Suspicious of carcinoma
diagnoses.final: Suspicious of malignancy (WHO Breast System). Suspicious of carcinoma.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Breast System – Suspicious of malignancy

categories.name: Malignant

rom.source: WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text – online beta

categories.management: MDT decides treatment. Suspicious axillary nodes: FNAB, then core if needed (may spare sentinel node procedure). Special-type carcinomas need excision for typing; cell block for ICC/biomarkers. [WHO book, paraphrased]

diagnoses.name: Invasive breast carcinoma
diagnoses.final: Malignant (WHO Breast System). Invasive breast carcinoma.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Breast System – Malignant
